title: Task Batch Create Input
description: Editor/CI aid for spur task batch-create --file input — the contract gating LLM decomposition output before any write. Every item is validated; any failure means nothing is written. RUNTIME SOURCE OF TRUTH is the Zod taskBatchSchema in @gobing-ai/spur-domain (packages/domain/src/planning/schema.ts); keep this file in sync with it.

name.description: Task title — used in slug and heading.

background.description: Context and motivation for the task.

requirements.description: R-numbered requirement items (R1. R2. …) — a referenceable list.

feature_id.description: Feature ID for traceability and Goal→Background derivation (DD-14).

parent_wbs.description: Parent WBS for sub-task grouping (the single sub-task convention, X02).

priority.description: Task priority aligned with the feature priority scale.

template.description: Template variant for section structure (default: the standard template).
